strings.app.title: Binary Sector Inspector
strings.welcome.tagline: Inspect binaries, a more modern way.
strings.welcome.drop: Drop a PE here (exe/dll/sys), or pass the path on the command line.
strings.welcome.author: Author
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.msaa_hint: Off on WARP. Recreates the render target, not the device.
strings.settings.renderer.hint: WARP if the GPU is a potato. Applied next frame. -sw on the command line still forces software for the session.
strings.pe.title: Inspector
strings.pe.hex_hint: Click a byte to edit. Save writes the patched PE.
strings.pe.tlib_raw: Not MSFT — raw blob, no field edit.
strings.pe.com_hint: COM / TYPELIB lives under COM. Edit, then Save to rebuild the file.
strings.pe.recompile_hint: Patches are in-place. Save writes a new PE (recompile).
strings.pe.version_hint: Edit FileVersion / ProductVersion and strings. Longer text only fits if the original slot has room. Save writes the PE.
strings.pe.ver_fit: String too long for in-place slot.
strings.pe.icon_hint: Replace needs the same byte size as the original RT_ICON (Resource Hacker-style in-place). Export writes a .ico.
strings.pe.icon_replaced: Icon patched. Save to write the PE.
strings.pe.icon_size: Replace failed: image byte size must match.
